title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Tacos, obviously—but don't stop at the obvious.
We ate tacos de canasta at Los Especiales, chiles en nogada and drowned tacos at Los Panchos, tacos al pastor at El Caifan, and a buffet at Cenote Ik Kil.
Mexican food is one of the easiest cuisines in the world to eat repeatedly without feeling like you are repeating yourself.
